AWPTCM-T37865.objective:
• With HANP enabled, PoE devices attached to the switch retain power during a warm restart (no power loss to PDs).
  • The Last negotiated time and date for PoE ports with attached devices remains the same before and after the warm restart.
  • HANP active status is logged during/after the restart.
  • HANP can be enabled globally and on a per-port basis (when globally enabled), with configuration and negotiated power info visible in CLI show commands.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability.

Enable HANP (globally and on relevant ports if applicable). Attach several PoE capable devices to the DUT. Verify via "show power-inline interface detail" that HANP is enabled, devices are powered, and Last negotiated time/date is displayed for all attached ports.

Perform a warm restart of the DUT (awplus#reboot). Monitor logs for HANP active messages. After reboot, verify no PoE devices lost power. Confirm Last negotiated times/dates on all ports with devices attached are the same as before the restart.
Verify CLI show commands display correct HANP system and interface level configuration and negotiated power info.
